title: Flood Crisis Management in Estuarine Areas
description: Flood Crisis Management in Estuarine Areas connects crisis-management fundamentals with flood inundation forecasting and decision-making. The technical core, Flood Inundation Forecasting Using AI, introduces the different information needed for flood risk and crisis management, physics-based modelling, computational constraints, and AI-based forecasting approaches including CNN, ANN and PINNs. Learners then connect forecasts, their temporal sequence and uncertainty to communication, stakeholder coordination and scenario-based response, recovery and resilience.
learningObjectives: Explain the main phases and principles of flood crisis management in estuarine and flood-prone areas.
Interpret flood-risk, situational-awareness and forecasting information to support crisis decisions.
Distinguish maximum inundation maps from time-dependent forecasts and describe the role of physics-based models and AI in flood forecasting.
Explain the roles of communication, stakeholder coordination, readiness and leadership during flood crises.
Evaluate an evolving flood scenario and identify appropriate preparedness, response, recovery and resilience actions.
integrationStatus: Active functional pilot course for the BONSAI-MOOC prototype.
